name: farm
title: Farms and crops: crop fields and crop water use

sources.name: agrimet_et
sources.license: U.S. Government work (public domain, inferred); provisional data

commands.name: farm-csb-load
commands.help: load a Crop Sequence Boundaries edition from its GeoPackage (--gpkg FILE --edition NAME)

commands.name: farm-cdl-load
commands.help: load the CDL classes, their crop groups and Idaho accuracy, and index the CDL rasters (--cdl DIR)

commands.name: farm-fields-load
commands.help: load a crop-fields build made in the worker image (--build DIR): agreement, July state, then growth

commands.name: farm-export
commands.help: export the crop fields and crop_cover.tif for the ground ($TVT_ARCHIVE/farm/export/<build>/)

storage: Crop fields: about 21,500 rows (the 2018-2025 CSB edition), 15-25 MB with indexes and the z8-10 dissolves; a few MB more per yearly edition, since fields that vanish are kept, closed. The CDL rasters indexed in farm.cdl_year are copied to $TVT_ARCHIVE/farm/cdl/ (about 25 MB, plus about 10 MB a year), and each build folder ($TVT_ARCHIVE/farm/build/<id>/: per-field stats and crop_cover.tif) and export is about 5-10 MB. Reloaded once a year, by hand.
ethics: AgriMet: static chart files only (robots.txt disallows /pn-bin and the RISE API, never used); one GET per file, 3 s apart, at most 12 a day in season and 6 a week off season (12 in the first two weeks of January); weather stations at agency sites; values are provisional and labelled so; credit Reclamation AgriMet. Crop fields: USDA NASS's Crop Sequence Boundaries and Cropland Data Layer (public domain), downloaded by hand with the owner's OK for each yearly edition, never scheduled; the outlines are modelled and are always called estimated fields. CSB has no owners, and fields are never joined to the Assessor's parcels in anything public. Growth flags join COMPASS's permits and plats (development's sources, republish yes).
